title: Telemetry Question Book
summary: Answer recurring telemetry questions from approved readings.
user: An engineering/support pair that repeatedly answers customer-impact questions from telemetry tools but cannot share broad access.
smallest_useful_product: A static local-first app that turns approved read-only links or CSV exports into named question cards with owner, freshness, threshold, and a shareable answer snapshot.
constraints: Use read-only, least-privilege links. Snapshots need expiry and redaction. Do not generate explanations with an LLM.
